# FG-DB-0022

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 500 |
| 重大度 | alert |
| Runbook | [`checks-reporting`](../../ops/runbooks/checks-reporting.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_stored_run_this_build_cannot_read_is_check_run_data_invalid` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: チェックの結果を読み取れませんでした。問い合わせ番号を添えて管理者に連絡してください。
- en: The check results could not be read. Contact the administrator with the request ID.
- id: Hasil pemeriksaan tidak dapat dibaca. Hubungi administrator dengan menyertakan ID permintaan.

## 原因 (cause)

Reading the check runs of a commit (forge_db::checks: the merge status through `CheckResultsSource`, the merge gate inside the merge request's transaction, `GET /api/v1/projects/{id}/commits/{sha}/checks`, or a report locking its run) found rows the forge-db commands never write: `reason=too_many_stored_runs` — more than 100 runs on one commit of one project (the cap is enforced by the application, FG-REVIEW-0021); `stored_name_invalid` — a name `CheckName::parse` refuses; `stored_status_invalid` — a status / conclusion pair outside the CHECKs (a conclusion without `completed`, or the reverse); `stored_annotation_invalid` — an annotation's level or line range outside its CHECK. The data was changed outside forge-db (a manual change, a restored dump, a dropped constraint). No run is skipped: a merge is refused and a status read fails rather than deciding on a partial set (skipping a run could turn a failure into `required_check_missing`, or the reverse).

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `reason`, `project_id` and `head_sha` (and `check_run_id` for a row); the name, summary and annotation text are not logged. Read read-only: SELECT id, name, status, conclusion, completed_at, revision FROM forge.check_runs WHERE project_id = <project_id> AND head_sha = '<head_sha>' ORDER BY id; SELECT count(*) FROM forge.check_runs WHERE project_id = <project_id> AND head_sha = '<head_sha>'; check pg_constraint for check_runs_name / check_runs_status / check_runs_conclusion_when_completed / check_annotations_level, and forge_audit.ddl_audit and the forge.audit_log `check_run.reported` / `check.completed` rows for who changed what.

## 対処 (fix)

Through an approved runbook step, delete the rows that break the rules (the reporter reports again; the audit log keeps every report) or restore them from a backup; restore a dropped constraint from the migration. Never edit the rows by hand without approval.
